senses.gloss: f. pl.cakes made of flour of parched grain, kneaded with oil, and intended to be reduced again to flour by rubbing between one’s hands; brittle cakes.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:5">Ḥall. I, 5</cite> <he>וכן הק׳ חייבות</he> and so are brittle cakes subject to Ḥallah; Y. ib. 57ᵈ sq. [read:] <he>וכן הק׳ חייבות … שלא תאמר וכ׳</he> and so are the brittle cakes subject &c., that you may not think, because they are to be reduced to flour, they ought to be exempt.
